description: Process a full or partial refund for a completed order.

order_id.description: ID of the order to refund

amount.description: Refund amount; must be positive and not exceed original transaction amount

reason.description: Reason for the refund: customer_request, defective, not_as_described, duplicate, or other

refund_method.description: Refund delivery method: original, store_credit, or bank_transfer

line_items.description: Optional list of specific line items to refund; if omitted, full refund is assumed
